LESSON: MEDICINAL TREES

Grade: Grade 5
Subject: HINDU RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: Creation (Srishti)
Topic 1.2: Medicinal Trees

SECTION 1: WELCOME

• Today’s class: Medicinal Trees
• How we learn: Teach → Worked example → Try this
• Use point notes. Show working. Then take the quiz.
• Big question: How are medicinal plants beneficial to mankind?

3. name the Enlightened Beings for familiarisation
